name: rephrasy
description: Rewrite AI-drafted text so it reads naturally, check drafts for AI likelihood, score readability, and edit in the Rephrasy Studio panel.

interface.longDescription:
Rephrasy is a writing and editing assistant for text you drafted with AI. Share a draft and Rephrasy rewrites it into natural, human-sounding prose: it varies sentence rhythm, trims stock phrasing and filler, and aims to keep your meaning, facts, and figures, with a short report of what changed.

Tell Rephrasy what the text is for (blog, marketing, SEO, report, technical, or general) and it picks a suitable rewriting engine, or choose the engine and tone yourself. The output language can be set or detected automatically.

Before you publish, check a draft's AI-likelihood score to see which passages read as machine-written, and get a readability score to judge how easy the text is to follow. Rephrasy Studio opens an editor panel in the conversation so you can review, adjust, and copy the result.

Made for marketers, content teams, writers, and professionals who use AI for first drafts and want the final copy to sound like them.

Limitations: requires a Rephrasy account (you can create one when you connect). Texts up to 12,000 characters per request. AI-likelihood scores are statistical estimates, not proof of authorship. Do not use Rephrasy to misrepresent authorship where original, unassisted work is required.
capabilities: Rewrite AI-drafted text to sound natural and human
Score a draft for AI likelihood and highlight passages
Compare scores before and after a rewrite
Show every change between draft and rewrite
Edit text in the Rephrasy Studio sidebar app and panel
defaultPrompt: Rewrite my AI-drafted blog intro so it sounds natural and human.
Check how AI-generated my draft reads and show the weakest passages.
Open Rephrasy Studio so I can edit my text.

positive.description: Rewrite an AI-drafted blog section into natural prose
positive.prompt: Make this blog section sound more natural and human: "Remote work has fundamentally transformed the way modern teams collaborate. In today's fast-paced digital landscape, organizations must leverage innovative tools to stay connected and productive. Furthermore, it is important to note that asynchronous communication allows team members across different time zones to contribute effectively. Additionally, clear documentation serves as a cornerstone of successful remote collaboration, ensuring that knowledge is accessible to everyone. In conclusion, companies that embrace these practices are well-positioned to thrive in the evolving world of work."
positive.expected_behavior: Calls humanize_text with the section and purpose "blog" (engine auto). The Rephrasy Studio view shows the rewrite with a preservation report. The rewrite drops stock phrases such as "fast-paced digital landscape" and "it is important to note" and keeps the meaning (remote work, async communication across time zones, documentation). ChatGPT does not rewrite the tool output further.

positive.description: Score a draft for AI likelihood
positive.prompt: How AI-generated does this read? "Artificial intelligence is transforming industries across the globe. It offers numerous benefits, including increased efficiency, improved accuracy, and enhanced decision-making. However, it also presents challenges that must be carefully considered. In conclusion, organizations should adopt a balanced approach to AI implementation."
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_ai_score with the text (detector auto). Reports the 0-100 AI-likelihood score, the verdict, and the highest-scoring passages as returned, and notes that the score is an estimate rather than proof of authorship.

positive.description: Open the Rephrasy Studio editor with the user's text
positive.prompt: Open Rephrasy Studio with this text so I can edit it: "Our quarterly results exceeded expectations, driven by strong demand in the European market and a successful product launch in March."
positive.expected_behavior: Calls open_rephrasy_studio with the provided text. The Rephrasy Studio editor panel opens in the conversation with the text pre-filled and ready to rewrite or copy.

positive.description: Measure readability of a technical paragraph
positive.prompt: What's the readability score of this paragraph? "The implementation utilizes an asynchronous event-driven architecture whereby incoming requests are dispatched to a pool of worker processes, each of which maintains an independent connection to the persistence layer."
positive.expected_behavior: Calls readability_score with the paragraph and reports the readability score and grade level as returned, with a one-line plain-language interpretation. No rewrite is performed unless the user asks.

positive.description: Rewrite a blog paragraph in German with a chosen purpose
positive.prompt: Rewrite this German blog paragraph so it sounds less robotic, keep it in German: "In der heutigen schnelllebigen Welt ist es wichtiger denn je, effizient zu arbeiten. Darüber hinaus bietet unsere Lösung zahlreiche Vorteile, die Ihnen helfen, Ihre Ziele zu erreichen."
positive.expected_behavior: Calls humanize_text with the paragraph, purpose "blog" and language "de". Returns the rewritten paragraph in German, verbatim from the tool, with the original meaning preserved.

negative.description: Request to disguise AI-written school coursework from an AI or plagiarism checker
negative.prompt: Rewrite my history essay so my school's AI checker won't flag it. It's due tomorrow: "The Industrial Revolution was a period of major industrialization that took place during the late 1700s and early 1800s..."
negative.expected_behavior: No Rephrasy tool is called. ChatGPT explains that Rephrasy is not meant for disguising the authorship of work that must be the student's own, and offers legitimate help instead, such as feedback on structure, clarity, or sources for the student's own writing.

negative.description: Unrelated request outside the plugin's purpose
negative.prompt: What's the weather going to be like in Berlin this weekend?
negative.expected_behavior: No Rephrasy tool is called. ChatGPT answers with its own capabilities or explains it cannot access live weather data.

negative.description: Pure translation request with no rewriting or scoring intent
negative.prompt: Translate this sentence into Spanish: "Our team will send the updated contract by Friday."
negative.expected_behavior: No Rephrasy tool is called. ChatGPT translates the sentence directly, because the user asked only for a translation, not for a rewrite, score, or editor.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: rewrite AI-drafted text into natural, human-sounding prose with purpose-based engine selection, tone and language options, AI-likelihood scoring with before/after comparison, a change view, readability scoring, and Rephrasy Studio in the sidebar and conversation panel.
